decision: D-010 (option A): Remove linked-worktree .deft/core reconstitution (reconstituteLinkedWorktreeDeposit, #4443 / #5390) for consumer projects. It serves the retired vendored layout, and new code never serves old-layout repos (section A9). Swarm worktree prep without a pin fails closed with the Rule 3 project-install message instead of copying content. Unit P2-U12 (#6562), two PRs, after P2-U2.
